item.tib: ma mo srid rgyal dpon g.yog gi mngon spyod las kyi byang bu
item.coloph: ma mo srid rgyal gtso 'khor gyi/ mngon sprod las kyi byang bu 'di/ dam ldan gshen gyi phyag cha 'di/ rnal 'byor khro bo'i mtshan 'chang bas/ yi ge ris su bkod pa ste/ ma sring tshogs la bzod gsol 'bul/ bstan pa rgyan gyur e ma dge/
